commits.edited_message:
first cpix implementation

Log the optional DRMSystem Name element for diagnostics when present.

(cherry picked from commit 22128c5a907814643364cb728f172d9c9d78bfb1)

crypt_xml_get_text(): avoid allocation as per https://github.com/gpac/gpac/pull/3851#discussion_r4044613073

Return the first non-empty text/CDATA child's content directly instead
of concatenating and copying into a newly allocated, trimmed buffer.

(cherry picked from commit 603241f1e715d62dfe2617a713fea86993016026)

coupling: crypt_xml_get_text() originally (52c1c23) allocated and returned an owned, caller-must-free buffer; every call site in cryptinfo_load_cpix freed its result. Later (a6193e1) the function was refactored to return a borrowed pointer directly into the XML DOM tree (child->name, owned by the parser and freed once when gf_xml_dom_del() tears down the tree); that commit correctly deletes the gf_free() call at each of the 3 call sites that existed in the real history (PlainValue, PSSH, HLSSignalingData). The injected edit to 52c1c23 adds a 4th call site (DRMSystem/Name, used only for a diagnostic log line) that calls crypt_xml_get_text() and frees its result, matching the allocating contract that was correct at the time 52c1c23 was written. a6193e1's diff never touches this call site (it is not part of that commit's hunk, and a commit-by-commit reviewer would not see it without greping the whole file for every caller of the function it refactors). Neither edit is wrong in isolation: reverting the 52c1c23 edit removes the 4th call site and the tree is safe (the function is still allocating, or if a6193e1's real patch applies on top, there is no stray caller left to misuse the new contract); reverting the a6193e1 edit restores the allocating crypt_xml_get_text(), under which the Name call site's gf_free() is correct again. Only the combination - borrowed-pointer semantics (a6193e1) plus an added caller still written against the old allocating contract (52c1c23) - produces a double free: the Name text's heap buffer is freed once explicitly in cryptinfo_load_cpix and again when gf_xml_dom_del() recursively frees every XML node's name field at the end of the same function.
